body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure all our core repos have auto release non pre release.' Unlike the game-client repos this pattern already landed on, emily.cli never had a distributable release at all. New release job cross-compiles linux/amd64+darwin/arm64+darwin/amd64 (verified locally). Windows dropped: confirmed via a real local cross-compile attempt that cmd/chat.go/gpt2.go/start.go use real Unix-only syscalls unconditionally, no build guard -- a real source gap, not fixed here, and not a meaningful target for this box-specific operator tool anyway. emily.cli bc0e508.

⚓ ☃
title: Auto-release CI -- first real distributable release for this CLI, linux+darwin cross-compiled
